service.name: Resistance Rank Boost
service.longDescription: The Bozjan southern front and the fields of Zadnor await. We grind your Resistance Rank from 1 to 25 through skirmishes, critical engagements and duels, unlocking every story beat and field note along the way.

rewards.title: Increased Resistance Rank
rewards.text: Your Bozja Rank increased to your desired level

rewards.title: Completion of Bozjan and Zadnor content
rewards.text: Bozja Story mode completed up to your desired level

rewards.title: Access to Main Raids
rewards.text: Gain access to the 48 Man Raids inside of Bozja

rewards.title: Access to Bozja exclusive mounts, minions, and cosmetics
rewards.text: Acquire mounts, minions and cosmetics from Bozja or Zadnor
